build.summary: start.sh patches installed vllm/v1/attention/backends/turboquant_attn.py in place with a backport of vLLM PR #40914 (routes uniform K+1 MTP spec-verify batches through the TurboQuant decode kernel; fixes garbled output, vLLM issue #40880); keeps .pre40914.bak and refuses to run if the anchor is not found

measured.concurrency_notes: max-num-seqs 1 by necessity (MTP + TurboQuant KV crashes with concurrency); 5.5 GiB KV pool = 286,466 tokens, 1.09x of 262k

extra_setup: Not Docker. start.sh: python3 -m venv .venv; pip install vllm==0.27.1 flashinfer-python>=0.6.13 nvidia-cutlass-dsl>=4.5.2; apply PR #40914 backport; snapshot_download RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 to MODEL_DIR (~22 GiB); if <Python.h> missing, installs uv CPython 3.14 and sets CC=~/.local/bin/cc-triton; GPU_UTIL auto = (free MiB - 820)/total clamped [0.80,0.98]; runs vllm serve with nohup, waits for /v1/models, then warms with a ~26K-token prefill. No CUDA toolkit needed.
notes: 0/15 garble-battery fails with patch (stock 0.27.1: 13/15). Vision not mentioned; not verified. Lower --max-model-len to raise --max-num-seqs (README table) but MTP+concurrency is flagged unstable. No LICENSE file.
